candidate.headline: AI Engineer | Full Stack Developer | Software Engineer

professional_summary: AI Engineer specializing in Large Language Model (LLM) integration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Generative AI application development, with hands-on experience shipping production-ready AI features using the Groq API, prompt engineering, and NLP techniques. Backed by strong engineering fundamentals in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, RESTful API design, and relational and NoSQL databases. Comfortable owning AI-driven applications end-to-end, from model/API integration to deployment, within Agile/Scrum and CI/CD workflows.

education.institution: Gyan Ganga Institute of Technology and Sciences

certifications.name: Generative AI with Large Language Models

bullets: Developed responsive, component-based user interfaces as part of front-end web development tasks in a virtual internship program.
Collaborated within an Agile/Scrum team using Git-based version control workflows, code reviews, and sprint planning ceremonies.
Wrote and executed test cases to identify UI regressions and improve overall application reliability and code quality.

projects.name: TokenGate
projects.subtitle: LLM Cost Gateway & API Management Platform
bullets: Engineered a unified REST API gateway in Node.js and Express.js that routes and manages requests across multiple third-party AI/LLM providers.
Built a full-stack analytics dashboard using React.js and TypeScript with authentication, API key management, request logging, and cost-trend visualization.
Implemented semantic caching and token-usage tracking to optimize API cost efficiency and reduce redundant LLM calls, using Redis for high-speed caching.
Designed a responsive, component-based frontend architecture with Vite, React Router, and TypeScript for type-safe, maintainable UI code.

projects.name: Mock.ai
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Voice Interview Platform
bullets: Developed a full-stack MERN application delivering AI-driven mock interview simulations, using LLM-generated questions to power role-based interview workflows.
Built reusable, responsive React.js components and implemented client-side routing for seamless interview and dashboard user flows.
Designed and integrated backend REST APIs in Node.js for user authentication, interview session management, and AI-generated interview question workflows.

projects.name: Healthify
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Health Assistant
bullets: Built a full-stack MERN application integrating AI-assisted conversation workflows with persistent, MongoDB-backed chat history across user sessions.
Developed reusable React.js frontend components connected to Node.js backend services via REST APIs for real-time AI-driven interaction.
Implemented data persistence and session management to maintain continuity of AI-driven user conversations.

projects.name: VibeCart
projects.subtitle: Full-Stack E-Commerce Platform
bullets: Engineered VibeBot, a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) customer support chatbot powered by the Groq API (Llama 3.3 70B) that retrieves live order and product data from MongoDB in real time to ground LLM responses in accurate store context.
Implemented real-time response streaming via Server-Sent Events (SSE) alongside a custom rate-limiting layer.
Architected a responsive e-commerce web application in React.js with reusable UI components, cart management, and end-to-end checkout workflows.
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs in Node.js and Express.js for product catalog, shopping cart, user authentication, and order management.

leadership_and_extracurricular.organization: Udyam E-Cell, Gyan Ganga Institute of Technology and Sciences
bullets: Coordinated cross-functional student teams and mentored peers through early-stage startup ideation and development.
Guided students in structuring pitch decks and facilitating group discussion and brainstorming sessions.
Organized and managed entrepreneurship events, coordinating logistics and student participation across multiple initiatives.
Contributed code, bug fixes, and documentation improvements to publicly hosted open-source repositories on GitHub.
Collaborated with project maintainers and other contributors through pull requests, issue discussions, and code review.
